justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: 22% injury reduction is a meaningful population-level effect. Secondary injury prevention (return-to-play decisions) well-documented.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Bachelor's/master's degree program (4+ years) plus extensive clinical hours; major educational investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Core credential for athletic training; applicable to entire AT scope of practice across all settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: BOC required for AT licensure in most states; enables direct billing where AT services are recognized by state Medicaid and commercial.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Required by law or employer in most AT positions; universally demanded for athletic training roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Athlete trust in AT relationship is high; immediate access improves experience vs delayed care.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Sports performance, tactical, and event-coverage consumers pay cash; strong fit for sports-focused practices.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Moderate — ATC alone doesn't command premiums, but combined with PT enables sports niche pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Dual-credentialed PT/ATC is genuinely differentiated in sports markets.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Can hire ATCs at lower cost than PTs to deliver event/sports services — strong leverage.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Athletes and teams recognize ATCs; consumer-facing brand is solid in sports.
justifications.business.efficiency: Full degree program — extremely high time/cost to acquire as a second credential.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Required credential for AT program faculty; in PT programs, valued for sports tracks.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: NATA Foundation funds research; strong publication culture in JAT.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent for sports PT, emergency response, and on-field assessment teaching.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid evidence base across acute injury management, concussion, and return-to-play.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Standard for AT programs; preferred in sports-residency-affiliated PT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Requires a full master's now — very inefficient if pursued purely for academic credit.
